_README: Keys are '<CODE>:<Symbol>' exactly as scripts/check_app_wiring.py prints them. The value is why the finding is accepted, and it should name the issue that will make it stop firing. Checked in BOTH directions: an entry whose finding no longer fires fails the run, so this file cannot rot into a list of things that used to be true. Delete an entry the moment its page lands.
_WHY_THIS_FILE_IS_LONG_TODAY: Every entry below is the same fact said twenty-five times: app/ is a skeleton whose ViewModels exist and whose Views do not, so every command and every observable property is genuinely bound to nothing. That is not a false positive; it is the guard correctly describing an unfinished app. Each entry names the issue whose page will bind it, and the entry must be deleted in that issue's own PR.
